rationale: Configuration/initial/finished encode state plus ordered code, empty initial storage, and code=[] respectively. Step.letValue consumes exactly the first statement, evaluates its expression using Eval, checks a fresh destination in the evaluated variable table and prepends its binding. EvalArgs threads storage left-to-right with a nil case; Eval.new checks declaration membership, arity and fresh nextId, then State.allocate zips results into fields and advances the counter. Eval.give and giveShare delegate to the cases introduced in shared.give. Steps is finite reflexive-transitive closure; Stuck is nonfinished with no successor. Pending constructor references remain results of EvalArgs until allocation, consistent with the paragraph and the soundness context.
